stage_0_to_stage_1.source: Tachibana, Nagahara & Ozawa 2001, LPSC XXXII #1767, p. 2 Fig. 1: pure-Fe condensation coefficient inferred from Fe-pellet backreaction; their fit assumes alpha_c = alpha_e at the measured interface. Reviewed b-878 value retained. Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.

reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant source-table gamma with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; source gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); verified solid-referenced CaO and MgO source gammas are converted to the declared liquid basis with the JANAF d-144 fusion chord; no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of the source gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload

stage_0_to_stage_1.source: Tachibana, Nagahara & Ozawa 2001, LPSC XXXII #1767, p. 2 Fig. 1: pure-Fe condensation coefficient inferred from Fe-pellet backreaction; their fit assumes alpha_c = alpha_e at the measured interface. Reviewed b-878 value retained. Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.

reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant source-table gamma with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; source gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); verified solid-referenced CaO and MgO source gammas are converted to the declared liquid basis with the JANAF d-144 fusion chord; no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of the source gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload

reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant source-table gamma with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; source gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); verified solid-referenced CaO and MgO source gammas are converted to the declared liquid basis with the JANAF d-144 fusion chord; no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of the source gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload

authority_exclusion.reason: K2O remains excluded from the openimcc activity authority above the cap by owner ruling of 2026-09-26, retained pending re-evaluation under the D066 pack (t-1194). The original ruling was established using published-core. For loaded pack default (IMCC-SF04-D066, version 1.0.3-d066-v1, digest 02c88c04fe09f8f494adda8a76e1f95fee536d11b2b6d66639aaea097fce5e75), KCaAlSi2O7 is inactive at 1473 K and inactive at 1673 K, with Gamma(KO0.5) values 1.67e-6 and 9.44e-6. Zhang et al. (2021, ACS Earth Space Chem.) measured alpha*Gamma(KO0.5) = 6.9e-8 at 1473 K and 1.11e-6 at 1673 K for the cited N-MORB-like basalt. Reviewed b-878 value retained. Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.

The original ruling was established using published-core. For loaded pack default (IMCC-SF04-D066, version 1.0.3-d066-v1, digest 02c88c04fe09f8f494adda8a76e1f95fee536d11b2b6d66639aaea097fce5e75), KCaAlSi2O7 is inactive at 1473 K and inactive at 1673 K, with Gamma(KO0.5) values 1.67e-6 and 9.44e-6. Zhang et al. (2021, ACS Earth Space Chem.) measured alpha*Gamma(KO0.5) = 6.9e-8 at 1473 K and 1.11e-6 at 1673 K for the cited N-MORB-like basalt. At this evaluated above-cap input, the OpenIMCC over constant-gamma K2O activity step is -0.03 dex. Constant-gamma K is also uncertified (t-999).

Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.

Reviewed b-878 value retained. Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.

reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant source-table gamma with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; source gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); verified solid-referenced CaO and MgO source gammas are converted to the declared liquid basis with the JANAF d-144 fusion chord; no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of the source gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload

The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.

reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant source-table gamma with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; source gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); verified solid-referenced CaO and MgO source gammas are converted to the declared liquid basis with the JANAF d-144 fusion chord; no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of the source gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload

reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant source-table gamma with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; source gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); verified solid-referenced CaO and MgO source gammas are converted to the declared liquid basis with the JANAF d-144 fusion chord; no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of the source gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload

reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant source-table gamma with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; source gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); verified solid-referenced CaO and MgO source gammas are converted to the declared liquid basis with the JANAF d-144 fusion chord; no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of the source gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload
